description: Latest election result for a UK parliamentary constituency: every candidate with party, votes and vote share, the winner, majority, electorate and turnout, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "who won in X and by how much?", including by-elections. Needs a constituency id (get one from constituency_search). Covers Westminster elections only, not local, mayoral or devolved elections. (cost: 1 credit)

constituencyId.description: integer, required, Parliament constituency id (from constituency_search), e.g. 4105 for Holborn and St Pancras

name: constituency_election_result
